justifications.durability: the declared mutation is applied and recorded: logs/negative-control.log runs the deferral without the attempt check and reddens tests/test_a_resume_is_not_halted_on_its_last_attempt.py:208 (starting vs blocked), :227 and :294, EXIT=1, so the first case's assertions fail on exactly the regression they guard.
justifications.evidence: the manifest records baseline_suite: pending and after_suite: pending and the logs it names (logs/head-gate.log:9, logs/base-gate.log:10) are truncated with no EXIT= line, so the arm evidence rests on the complete arms logs/base-93e347dba.log ('3 failed, 709 passed', EXIT=1) and logs/head-93e347dba.log ('3 failed, 709 passed', EXIT=1); added_failure_count is 0 because the base arm's three failures are the three new tests (which pass at head) and the head arm's three failures are untouched tests that pass serially (recheck-three.log, 25 passed), i.e. parallel-contention flakes rather than failures the change adds.
justifications.fit: the new helpers follow the surrounding recovery_liveness.py idiom (recovery_liveness.py:398-420 _attempt_started_seconds) and their names (_attempt_awaits_its_worker, _resumed_launch_is_stranded, _stranded_attempt_clause) carry no version, plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:796-805 defers the death branch to the attempt the run's own record names, so the previous attempt's exited process no longer draws a resuming run halted, matching the goal.
justifications.reuse: the additions extend existing owners rather than fork them -- _current_attempt_number (recovery_liveness.py:427) reads attempt.json as _attempt_started_seconds already does, _worker_record_names_attempt wraps _worker_record and _exit_record_names_attempt wraps _run_exit_record, and _resumed_launch_is_stranded covers the pid-naming case _stranded_launch (recovery_liveness.py:561) cannot see.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff 93e347dba..f0240197a (reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py, reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py, tests/test_a_resume_is_not_halted_on_its_last_attempt.py) is inside the manifest's declared write_paths.
